purpose: Capability contract for charts, fundamental graphs, historical prices, financial statements, and option chains. Documented but unbound actions are not executable.

actions.completion: TradingView interval label matches
range control and visible time axis agree
chart style control and renderer type agree
scale label and price-axis behavior agree
exact requested security appears once in the comparison legend
exact live indicator identity appears once
drawings toolbar visibility matches
active layout name matches exactly
explicit confirmation followed by native saved-layout acknowledgement
explicit confirmation followed by one matching alert in the native alert list
non-empty artifact or verified snapshot URL

voice: Make this a one-hour candle chart for six months on log scale.
Save a snapshot of this chart.

actions.completion: company series exists exactly once
native Range value matches
native estimate boolean matches
exact Quarterly/Annual selector has the unique rendered selected state
exact Overlay/Split selector has the unique rendered selected state
native selector and rendered chart unit both match
metric series exists for every requested company and no unavailable-data banner appears
per-series style control and renderer agree
series axis control and displayed axis agree
series scale control matches
transform control and plotted series agree
chooser opens; no download success claimed

blockers: GF P/E is not separately verified as forward or trailing; forward P/E requests should use EM or ERN.
Export artifact types are not verified.
voice: Add Microsoft and Meta, show five years of operating margin with estimates.
Split this graph and switch it to annual data.

actions.completion: inputs plus first/last loaded rows match
control and row timestamp granularity match
page indicator changes once
all loaded rows exist in a non-empty expected-format artifact

blockers: Browser download gate is not wired.
voice: Switch these historical prices to one-minute rows.
Export every loaded row to Excel.

actions.completion: selected statement and table headings match
control and fiscal columns match
non-empty expected-format artifact passes download gate

voice: Switch this to the annual cash-flow statement.

actions.completion: slider, independent N Strikes label and changed rendered option-table signature agree
semantic mode and displayed sides agree
expiry control and every contract row expiry agree
control and displayed expiry horizon agree
rendered strikes above spot equal request
rendered strikes below spot equal request
exact requested Greek columns are visible/hidden
visible ordered columns match exactly
exact selected option identity opens in destination

blockers: Expiration and column lists must be read from the live option chain.
“N strikes around spot” is ambiguous; above and below must be specified separately.
Option entitlement and one exact selected contract are prerequisites.
No action may place an order.
voice: Show fifteen strikes in the Apple option chain.
Show calls, three months out, ten strikes above and five below, with delta gamma vega and theta.
Open the selected contract in Black-Scholes.

integration_state: partially integrated; OMON native strike depth is executable, while other candidates remain separated into source-verified, documented-unbound and blocked actions
